fields.title: agent: bundled smart/deep include unavailable memory tool
fields.description: Spawning bundled smart/deep agents fails before execution with: Invalid tools for agent "smart/deep": memory. Available tool inventory contains agent, apply_patch, backlog, bash/exec_command, exa tools, read/write/edit, ralph/autoresearch tools, etc., but not memory. Need trace agent definition/tool policy resolution, remove stale memory from bundled agent defaults or ensure memory is only included when registered, add regression coverage, and verify extensions/tau gate.
